articles.title: Lane Kiffin braces for ‘hatred’ and safety concerns ahead of highly anticipated Ole Miss return
articles.standfirst: The LSU coach is preparing for an emotional night as he faces the Ole Miss fans he left behind
articles.summary: The LSU coach is preparing for an emotional night as he faces the Ole Miss fans he left behind
articles.body:
Lane Kiffin is preparing for one of the most uncomfortable nights of his coaching career when he returns to Oxford on Saturday, with the LSU coach admitting he expects intense hostility and heightened security during his first visit back to Ole Miss .

Kiffin left the Rebels for LSU last November after guiding Ole Miss to unprecedented success, accepting a reported seven-year, $91 million contract just before the program's College Football Playoff appearance.

His decision left a bitter taste among many supporters, making Saturday's top-10 SEC showdown far more personal than an ordinary rivalry game.

Speaking ahead of the contest, Kiffin acknowledged that safety has become a genuine concern. Security preparations have been increased around Vaught-Hemingway Stadium, while officials are expected to closely monitor the passionate crowd.

Kiffin , meanwhile, believes the attention directed toward him could actually benefit his LSU players by allowing them to focus without carrying the burden of the controversy.

“But I told the players today, man, like, ‘You don't have anything to worry about as far as, like, attention on you all week. There's just going to be so much attention, hatred - everything - on me’,” said Kiffin .

Kiffin has attempted to shift the pressure toward Ole Miss, as he pointed to the Rebels' 13-win campaign last season and the return of quarterback Trinidad Chambliss and running back Kewan Lacy, both considered early Heisman Trophy candidates.

Kiffin also emphasized that he played a significant role in developing both stars during his five seasons in Oxford.

Familiar faces add another layer

The coaching storyline is equally compelling. Pete Golding , who worked alongside Kiffin for more than three years as Ole Miss' defensive coordinator, now leads the Rebels. That familiarity could give Ole Miss valuable insight into LSU's offensive system, although Kiffin has also spent years studying Golding's defensive tendencies.

Kiffin believes the advantage may lean toward Golding because a defensive coordinator hears directly from a head coach about the concepts, formations and plays that create problems. Golding has spent years listening to Kiffin explain what he dislikes facing, potentially giving Ole Miss valuable information when the teams meet.

Still, LSU has attempted to evolve its offense since Kiffin's arrival. While speed and creativity remain central to his philosophy, the Tigers have placed greater emphasis on physicality, particularly along the offensive line and in the running game.

The early numbers suggest that approach is producing results. LSU has opened the season 2-0 and accumulated 1,172 yards through two games, while its defense ranks among the nation's best. Ole Miss, meanwhile, remains dangerous behind Chambliss and Lacy but has shown considerably more uncertainty on defense.

The stakes are historic, as LSU and Ole Miss are meeting as top-10 teams for the first time in 64 years, giving the matchup national significance beyond Kiffin's return.

Saturday's result will be decided by the players rather than the storyline and Kiffin knows that better than anyone, joking that he won't be the person making tackles or throwing touchdowns.

But with the former Ole Miss coach returning to the program he helped rebuild, the atmosphere in Oxford promises to be one of the most intense of the college football season.

articles.title: Arch Manning had something to say about Holly Rowe and later apologizes
articles.standfirst: Manning issued a direct apology after laughing at a fake clip involving Steve Sarkisian
articles.summary: Manning issued a direct apology after laughing at a fake clip involving Steve Sarkisian
articles.body:
A rch Manning ’s week began with one of the biggest wins of his college career. It quickly shifted into damage control after a press-conference joke about a fake video involving Holly Rowe drew widespread criticism.

The Texas quarterback apologized Tuesday for laughing at an AI-generated clip that falsely depicted Longhorns coach Steve Sarkisian slapping the veteran ESPN reporter.

Manning had referenced the video while discussing social-media edits that followed Texas’ dramatic 24-23 comeback win over No.1 Ohio State .

“I saw an AI edit of Sark's interview,” Manning said during the press conference. “That's a good one, of him slapping Holly Rowe. That's hilarious.”

Laughter could also be heard from others in the room. The reaction quickly became a story of its own, and Manning later acknowledged that he had handled the moment poorly.

“In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote on Instagram.

“It's easy to say I didn't mean it, but I know my words and actions were hurtful to a lot of people. I do not take the lightly and am deeply sorry for that.”

Manning makes personal apology to Rowe

Manning ’s statement went beyond a general apology and addressed Rowe directly.

“I specifically want to apologize to Holly Rowe for what she has personally had to deal with because of my comments,” he wrote.

“I have a ton of respect for her and appreciate her showing me grace in the moment. I need to do better and will be more thoughtful going forward.”

Rowe responded publicly and indicated that the issue had already been discussed between them.

“I appreciate our conversation about this, which will remain private,” Rowe said. “Apology accepted. We move forward with respect and kindness for one another.”

That exchange helped close the loop on an episode that began with a real, but nonviolent, postgame interaction between Rowe and Sarkisian .

After Texas completed its comeback against Ohio State, Rowe attempted to continue an interview with the Longhorns coach.

Sarkisian cut the exchange short, saying, “That's called Texas fight. Hook 'em,” before walking away.

The AI edit then manipulated that moment to make it appear as if Sarkisian struck Rowe . He did not.

Reporter also walks back framing of Manning’s comments

Evan Vieth of Inside Texas, who posted the press-conference clip, initially described Manning’s response as “gold” and presented it as an example of his personality.

Vieth later apologized for that framing after the backlash intensified. The timing made the controversy especially striking.

Manning had just completed 23 of 37 passes for 195 yards, one touchdown and one interception while helping Texas erase a 20-point deficit against the nation’s No.1 team.

By Tuesday, however, the focus had shifted away from the field. Manning did not try to defend the joke. He acknowledged the harm, apologized directly to Rowe and said he needed to “be more thoughtful going forward.”

articles.title: Bill Belichick lashes out at accusations girlfriend, Jordon Hudson, is running his coaching career
articles.standfirst: The 74-year-old coach insists Hudson has no official role with North Carolina football
articles.summary: The 74-year-old coach insists Hudson has no official role with North Carolina football
articles.body:
Bill Belichick has heard the speculation surrounding Jordon Hudson for months. Now, he is making clear where he believes the line has been badly blurred.

The 74-year-old North Carolina coach dismissed claims that his 25-year-old girlfriend has become deeply involved in his football operation, saying reports about her influence have grown far beyond reality.

“The way the story was picked up was a long way from that,” Belichick told the Wall Street Journal. “Like, ‘She’s trying to be the general manager of the team,’ and it’s so ridiculous.”

Hudson has been a highly visible presence around Belichick , including at games and public appearances, and questions about her role intensified after reports that she had been copied on some communications connected to the coach. Belichick said that interpretation missed the point.

Emails were about personal schedule

Belichick explained that when he arrived at North Carolina, he was juggling several commitments outside football.

“When I took the job here, it was December, and at that time I was doing five TV shows, the radio show, I had a book coming out,” he said. “I had a lot of other things going on when I took the job.”

According to Belichick , that was why he asked university staff to send certain requests to Hudson .

“I sent an email when I got here and I said, ‘Can you please forward any requests to Jordon about my personal appearances so that I can work and coordinate them outside the university?’” he said. “Didn’t have anything to do with the university.”

He said that message was later portrayed as evidence Hudson was copied into virtually every aspect of his work.

“That was leaked [and] released as ‘Jordon’s involved in every single thing that I do and she’s copied on every email,’” Belichick said. “Just a flat-out lie.”

Asked what Hudson does help with, Belichick kept the distinction simple.

“There are some things that she helps me schedule or look at,” he said. “It’s not North Carolina stuff.”

A university spokesperson also told the Wall Street Journal that Hudson has no football “responsibilities.”

Scrutiny around couple has only grown

Hudson does have business ties to Belichick outside football. She lists herself as COO of Belichick Productions and founded Trouble Cub Enterprises, which has sought trademarks linked to phrases associated with the longtime coach.

The relationship drew wider attention after a CBS Sunday Morning interview in 2025, when Hudson interrupted a question about how the couple met. “We’re not talking about that,” she said from off camera.

Belichick later defended her, arguing that the interview was supposed to focus on his book and that Hudson was trying to steer the conversation back to the agreed subject. He has also repeatedly brushed aside criticism of their age gap.

“I’ve never been too worried about what everybody else thinks,” Belichick said. “Just try to do what I feel like is best for me and what’s right.”

articles.title: Bill Belichick makes another controversial decision at UNC: "Nepotism runs deep"
articles.standfirst: Belichick is off to a strong start in his second season with the North Carolina Tar Heels.
articles.summary: Belichick is off to a strong start in his second season with the North Carolina Tar Heels.
articles.body:
Heading into his second season with the North Carolina Tar Heels , just about everyone was preparing themselves to watch a true implosion for UNC with Bill Belichick at the helm. Through two games, they'll have to keep waiting.

Belichick's squad opened the season with a pivotal road win over TCU , who embarrassed them in last season's first game. UNC then trounced East Tennessee State in the second game, setting them on the right course under Belichick. Those two wins came as the Tar Heels football program is still in a pattern of chaos.

On Thursday, it was reported that general manager Michael Lombardi has finally resigned from his position , after having been placed on paid administrative leave during the summer. Lombardi isn't alone in exiting the building, though. Defensive coordinator Steve Belichick - Bill's son - has also resigned , after a stint on medical leave that began on August 6.

Michael Lombardi and Steve Belichick resign, Bill identifies Brian Belichick as his next DC

Replacing Lombardi isn't exactly necessary, as the GM position was more something an NFL franchise would do. But defensive coordinator is a crucial job, and Bill has already chosen someone to replace his son: his other son, Brian Belichick .

Brian spent the 2025 season as the team's defensive backs/safeties coach . He was previously with his father with the New England Patriots , working under the head coach since 2017.

Brian had called defensive plays during North Carolina's first two games - which went swimmingly considering they've only allowed 13 points in two contests. But his promotion has rubbed some people the wrong way, simply due to the nature of their relationship.

" What in the Game of Thrones is going on here "

" The nepotism knows no bounds "

There are more qualified candidates than Belichick, but he's obviously familiar with the system and players on the team. Still, the optics aren't the best for a football program that's already under a microscope.

articles.title: Lane Kiffin’s daughter suffers vulgar backlash from Ole Miss fans over her father’s drastic decision that enraged them
articles.standfirst: She remains a student at the university her father decided to leave
articles.summary: She remains a student at the university her father decided to leave
articles.body:
L andry Kiffin woke up to photographs of vulgar banners hanging from houses around Oxford, Mississippi. The messages made sexual claims about Lane Kiffin’s daughter and linked her to former Ole Miss running back Ulysses Bentley IV, a man she says she has “genuinely never met” in her life.

“I don’t think it should be okay to turn a girl into the punchline of a sexual joke just because you’re angry with someone she is related to,” Landry said. “I am my own person.” There is no public evidence supporting the rumor, nor are there any lawsuits or formal complaints involving Landry and Bentley.

Why Ole Miss fans are angry with Lane Kiffin

The hostility stems from Kiffin’s controversial departure from Ole Miss in November 2025. After leading the Rebels to an 11-1 regular-season record and their first College Football Playoff appearance, he accepted a seven-year, $91 million contract to become LSU’s head coach .

He asked to remain at Ole Miss during the playoffs, but athletic director Keith Carter rejected the request and promoted Pete Golding. Kiffin later admitted that he regretted how he handled the “messy” departure.

Many Ole Miss supporters viewed that departure as a betrayal, especially because Kiffin joined an SEC rival and several assistants and players eventually followed him to LSU. Ole Miss has since sued former Rebels players Princewill Umanmielen and Devin Harper over alleged breaches of their revenue-sharing agreements. However, those cases are against the players not Landry and provide no support for the sexual claims displayed on the banners.

Landry, 21, is still pursuing a degree in business administration at Ole Miss and is a member of the Kappa Kappa Gamma sorority. That connection made the attack even more painful: she has repeatedly expressed how much she loves the university and her life in Oxford, even after her father left for LSU.

Lane Kiffin will now return to Oxford wearing LSU colors, fully aware that he will be booed by the same fan base that once celebrated him. Fans have every right to reject his decision or question the way he left, but Landry’s message drew a clear human boundary: anger toward a football coach does not justify taking it out on him through his daughter. She had nothing to do with her father’s decision.

articles.title: Bill Belichick's son, Steve, resigns from the UNC coaching staff amid drugs investigation
articles.standfirst: The decision means Bill has to search for a new permanent defensive coordinator for the Tar Heels.
articles.summary: The decision means Bill has to search for a new permanent defensive coordinator for the Tar Heels.
articles.body:
Steve Belichick 's time at the University of North Carolina has come to an abrupt end after the school concluded an investigation into conduct involving the Tar Heels defensive coordinator. Belichick , the son of legendary football coach Bill , was hired as North Carolina 's defensive coordinator in December 2024 after previously holding the same position at Washington Huskies .

His arrival gave the Tar Heels another connection to his father, who took over as North Carolina 's head coach, but after a disappointing first season, Steve ’s future then became uncertain amid an investigation into alleged conduct involving drugs. Steve had been on medical leave since August 6 while the university examined the allegations, and reports indicated officials were investigating potential drug use while he was working, as well as accusations that he may have provided drugs to players. North Carolina has not publicly confirmed that Steve was the subject of the investigation, with former general manager Michael Lombardi also departing his position during the same period. The school announced that its investigation had concluded, saying certain actions demonstrated “a disregard for Carolina ’s values and standards of conduct.” “These actions were isolated in scope and not a systemic failure,” the University of North Carolina said. “All necessary corrective actions are now underway, and will be overseen by Carolina Athletics and the Office of University Counsel. “With these actions, the University considers the investigation to be resolved.” While Steve was away from the program, his brother Brian took over defensive play-calling duties. He is expected to continue handling those responsibilities following the departure.

Tar Heels demolish East Tennessee despite Steve Belichick saga

The developments surrounding Steve came as North Carolina opened the 2026 NCAA season 2-0 after dominating East Tennessee State Buccaneers 35-3 in its home opener on Saturday, September 12. Demon June powered the offense with three rushing touchdowns, while Billy Edwards threw for two scores in the first quarter as the Tar Heels quickly established control to impress their eight-time Super Bowl -winning coach. Edwards completed 15 of 20 passes for 244 yards while spreading the ball among eight receivers. Jelani Thurman led the team with 71 receiving yards, including a 24-yard catch-and-run that opened the scoring. And the defense was equally impressive despite the turmoil surrounding its coaching staff as North Carolina limited ETSU to 255 yards, forced two turnovers and recorded four sacks. Jaylen Harvey and Xavier Lewis each recorded two sacks as the Tar Heels extended their defensive streak to seven consecutive quarters without allowing a touchdown to continue their strong start to the season. The Tar Heels will now face a much tougher test when they visit the Clemson Tigers on September 19 in the ACC.

articles.title: Deion Sanders opens a box and gets back what blood clots took from him four years ago
articles.standfirst: Coach Prime received two prosthetic toes and turned an emotional step in his recovery into a moment filled with laughter
articles.summary: Coach Prime received two prosthetic toes and turned an emotional step in his recovery into a moment filled with laughter
articles.body:
D eion Sanders opened what appeared to be an ordinary box, but what he found inside gave him back something he had been missing for four years. The Colorado coach finally received two prosthetic toes after a frightening medical battle forced doctors to amputate part of his left foot.

Sanders immediately found a way to bring humor to the emotional moment. He admired the toenails and the close match to his skin tone, joked that the toes had been wrapped like a gift and celebrated that he could finally return to wearing his usual size 11.5 shoes.

Deion Sanders is finally ‘10 toes down again’

The new toes initially felt tight, prompting Coach Prime to joke that they had not yet “made friends” with the rest of his foot . Once they were in place, however, he proudly looked toward the camera and declared: “I’m 10 toes down again.”

The lighthearted video carried a much deeper meaning. Sanders had two toes amputated after developing life-threatening blood clots that placed both his leg and his life in danger. At one point, doctors even considered amputating his leg below the knee .

Deion Sanders isHis health journey has continued through numerous procedures and a more recent battle with bladder cancer. Sanders underwent surgery and later announced that he was cancer-free, adding another chapter to a recovery that has repeatedly tested him physically and emotionally.

Sanders is in his fourth season as head coach of the Colorado Buffaloes after arriving in Boulder in 2023 . In March 2025, he signed a five-year, $54 million extension that keeps him under contract through 2029. Away from football, he is currently dating actress Karrueche Tran, who supported him during his battle with bladder cancer; his engagement to television producer Tracey Edmonds ended in 2023.

articles.title: Jen Belichick disputes reports surrounding Steve’s sudden North Carolina departure
articles.standfirst: UNC ended a wide-ranging football investigation without publicly tying Belichick to a specific finding
articles.summary: UNC ended a wide-ranging football investigation without publicly tying Belichick to a specific finding
articles.body:
Steve Belichick ’s departure from North Carolina has left one major question hanging over the program: how much of the speculation surrounding his exit is actually true?

His wife, Jen Belichick , challenged parts of the public narrative after UNC announced Thursday that the 39-year-old defensive coordinator had resigned following a medical leave that began August 6.

“Unfortunately there is misinformation and speculation about our own situation,” she said in a statement.

She didn't identify which reports she believed were false, but her comments came as North Carolina released the findings of an internal investigation into the football program that examined a range of allegations involving drugs, relationships and possible NCAA issues.

UNC said the review “determined that certain actions demonstrated a disregard for Carolina's values and standards of conduct,” while also stressing that the conduct was “isolated in scope and not a systemic failure.”

The university didn't publicly tie Steve Belichick to a specific finding of misconduct.

Investigation was broader than Steve Belichick

Lead investigator Nate Huff , a former federal prosecutor, said more than 60 people were interviewed during a review that extended across the football operation.

“Our scope was broad, so we looked into a lot of stuff,” Huff told The Associated Press.

Reports had indicated that witnesses were questioned about potential drug use involving Belichick , but questions raised during an investigation are not the same as confirmed findings. Huff emphasized that the inquiry was not built around one person.

“This was not a circumstance where we were targeting any individual person or any specific people,” he said. “We were looking program-wide -- football program-wide.”

Former general manager Michael Lombardi also resigned during the wider investigation after previously being placed on paid administrative leave.

Jen Belichick centers health in response

Jen Belichick ’s statement focused less on the investigation itself and more on her husband’s well-being.

“Our priority will always be to show up with a healthy and strong mind for ourselves and our 5 children,” she said.

“We are humbled by the relationships that have been fostered here in North Carolina and would like to thank each and every person that has positively impacted our experience.”

She continued: “We believe prioritizing health as the most important thing you can do in this life and is invaluable compared to anything else.”

Steve Belichick joined North Carolina in 2025 to coach under his father, Bill Belichick , with his brother Brian also on staff. His resignation becomes official October 27 when his medical leave ends.

Brian Belichick has since been elevated to lead the defense. UNC has said it considers the investigation resolved, although school officials have left the door open to revisiting the matter if credible new information emerges.

Jen Belichick ’s statement doesn't fully explain what led to her husband’s departure, but it makes one thing clear: the family believes at least some of the claims surrounding Steve Belichick’s exit don't reflect the full story.

articles.summary: Scandal close to the legendary head coach has rocked the Tar Heels.

S teve Belichick 's resignation has added another major twist to Bill Belichick 's turbulent start at North Carolina , with questions now growing over the legendary coach's own future in Chapel Hill .

The Tar Heels announced on September 17 that Steve will resign as defensive coordinator effective October 27, following the conclusion of his medical leave. The move came alongside UNC 's announcement that its investigation had ended.

Steve had been on medical leave since August 6 as the university examined allegations connected to the football program linked to alleged drug use and other conduct within the program, although UNC did not identify specific individuals.

“The University has concluded a thorough and independent investigation,” UNC said in its statement. “Into allegations related to culture and climate within the Carolina football program.”

The school added: “The investigation determined that certain actions demonstrated a disregard for Carolina’s values and standards of conduct. The investigation also found that these actions were isolated in scope and not a systemic failure.”

UNC also confirmed that former general manager Michael Lombardi resigned effective September 3, while Steve will depart after his medical leave concludes.

As per WRAL, the investigation included an interview with Bill , and that investigators conducted about 60 interviews while examining allegations involving the program, but the school has not specifically linked Steve or Lombardi to the investigation's findings.

The decision leaves important questions unanswered about the circumstances surrounding both departures and what they could mean for Bill – although UNC has not announced disciplinary action against the head coach.

Still, the departure of his son and Lombardi leaves him facing another major change less than two years into his North Carolina tenure and the college football insider Steven Godfrey suggested that the latest development could foreshadow a larger change.

“Everybody expects Bill Belichick and North Carolina to move on in the near future, and this is just another sign of that,” Godfrey said, but for now, Bill remains North Carolina's head coach, and the university has not indicated that his position is changing.

Who do the Tar Heels play next?

North Carolina has started the 2026 season 2-0, giving Bill 's team some momentum on the field despite the turmoil surrounding the program as the Tar Heels now face their first major test against the Clemson Tigers .

North Carolina routed the East Tennessee State Buccaneers 35-3 on September 12, with Billy Edwards throwing for 244 yards and Jelani Thurman leading the team with 71 receiving yards in a convincing home victory.

The Tar Heels ' defense also impressed, limiting ETSU to 255 total yards while forcing two turnovers and recording four sacks as Brian Belichick has handled defensive play-calling during Steve 's absence.

But Clemson represents a significant step up in competition as responded with a 22-7 victory over the Georgia Southern after they opened the season with a 51-10 loss to the LSU Tigers.

A strong performance at Clemson could give North Carolina an early statement in the ACC , a conference that includes the Miami Hurricanes . For now, the focus shifts back toward Bill ’s season, but for how much longer will he remain?

articles.title: Kayla Saager-Beckley Cause of Death: How did former college soccer star die?
articles.standfirst: The former soccer captain died suddenly in Tulsa.
articles.summary: The former soccer captain died suddenly in Tulsa.
articles.body:
K ayla Saager-Beckley ’s family is mourning the former Binghamton University soccer captain after she died suddenly in Tulsa , Oklahoma , just months after marrying her husband, John Beckley . The 30-year-old Saager-Beckley collapsed about 10 minutes after completing a workout on September 9 whilst she was pregnant. Her unborn daughter, Sawyer , did not survive the accident.

Binghamton also confirmed her death on September 10, remembering a player who became one of the program’s standout strikers, known for her fierce competitiveness with a deep passion for soccer. Saager-Beckley scored 22 goals across two seasons with the Bearcats from 2017-18, and she was a two-time all-region selection and earned America East Striker of the Year honors in 2017. That 2017 season became a defining chapter in Binghamton history as Saager-Beckley helped the Bearcats win the America East championship, completing a remarkable turnaround after finishing last in the conference one year prior. After college, Saager-Beckley continued her playing career in the Czech Republic before moving into coaching and recruiting. She later spent four years as an assistant at Troy University while earning a master’s degree. She joined the University of Tulsa ’s coaching staff in 2025 and had recently moved into college soccer scouting and recruiting. Her move to Oklahoma came after she married Beckley in June, adding another layer of heartbreak to the loss. And on Monday, September 14 the Tulsa head football coach Tre Lamb confirmed the sudden nature of the tragedy, whilst John issued a moving statement. “Kayla was a beautiful, loving and unforgettable soul,” said John . “Whose laughter, kindness and love touched so many lives. She and Sawyer will forever remain in the hearts of all who knew and loved them.”

Kayla Saager-Beckley Cause of Death

Saager-Beckley is survived by her husband, John , her parents Ron and Noranne , and her sisters Rachel and Veronica , but the death has left former teammates, coaches and the wider soccer community grieving. The exact cause of Saager-Beckley ’s death remains unknown while officials conduct their investigation. The Tulsa County Medical Examiner’s Office said additional testing is needed before an official determination can be made. “A report won’t be available until we have concluded all of our tests,” a spokesperson for the Tulsa County Medical Examiner’s Office told The New York Post. “Which will take roughly three to six months.” Her family has since remembered Kayla and Sawyer as deeply loved members of their family with a powerful statement, whilst they also shared funeral and celebration-of-life information. “Kayla was a beautiful, loving and unforgettable soul whose laughter, kindness and love touched so many lives,” the statement said. “She and Sawyer will forever remain in the hearts of all who knew and loved them.” The family also requested memorial donations to two organizations: St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital and The Bee Foundation , which supports awareness, education, prevention and research surrounding brain aneurysms.

articles.title: Lane Kiffin turns into supervillain as LSU source claims he wants to keep hurting Ole Miss
articles.standfirst: Kiffin returns to Ole Miss this weekend to face the team he left before the College Football Playoff last season.
articles.summary: Kiffin returns to Ole Miss this weekend to face the team he left before the College Football Playoff last season.
articles.body:
Week 3 of the college football season is set to deliver one of the most anticipated matchups of the entire year. No. 7 LSU visiting No. 8 Ole Miss would already be considered a mouthwatering matchup from a pure football perspective, but the backstory is too good to be true.

Current LSU head coach Lane Kiffin spent six seasons at Ole Miss, turning the Rebels into one of the best teams in the nation, particularly in his final three seasons. The 2025 season was easily the best, as the team was 11-1 and set to make noise in the College Football Playoff . But then Kiffin left the team right before the CFP .

Kiffin accepted the LSU head coaching job on November 30 , leaving his Ole Miss players with an interim head coach for the most important stretch of the season. The Rebels did well without Kiffin, crushing 11th-seeded Tulane and taking down 3rd-seeded Georgia to reach the semifinals. They held strong against the Miami Hurricanes , but couldn't make it to the national championship game.

Ole Miss Rebels don't like Lane Kiffin, and he doesn't like them

Meanwhile, Kiffin was hard at work recruiting players - reportedly even some Ole Miss guys who were still playing - to join the Tigers for the 2026 season . Kiffin's actions, unsurprisingly, rubbed many at Ole Miss the wrong way. Kiffin apparently feels that they should be grateful for what he helped build, though.

According to Chris Low of On3 , Kiffin is taking the LSU-Ole Miss game as personally as the program he left is; perhaps even more so. He really wants to stick it to Ole Miss .

It sounds like Kiffin wants to win and win big. It wouldn't surprise anyone if he even tries to run up the score, assuming LSU is ahead if that opportunity arises.

Ole Miss hopes it doesn't come to that. Instead, the home crowd is expecting to make things very rowdy for Kiffin in his return to Oxford, Mississippi .

articles.title: The real reason Morgan Freeman is picking Ole Miss to beat LSU
articles.standfirst: Freeman makes his choice as LSU prepares for hostile Oxford return
articles.summary: Freeman makes his choice as LSU prepares for hostile Oxford return
articles.body:
Morgan Freeman made his choice clear on Saturday morning: he’s backing Ole Miss to beat LSU.

The legendary actor appeared on ESPN’s College GameDay as the celebrity guest picker ahead of one of the most anticipated games of the college football season.

No. 8 Ole Miss and No. 7 LSU entered the showdown undefeated at 2-0, while the matchup carried an additional storyline because LSU head coach Lane Kiffin was returning to Oxford for the first time since leaving the Rebels.

However, there was little mystery surrounding which side Freeman would support.

The Oscar-winning actor wore an Ole Miss hat during the broadcast before eventually making his selection. After Nick Saban picked LSU, Freeman acknowledged the former Alabama coach before revealing his own choice.

“In spite of my belief in your every thought. Ole Miss!” Freeman said, prompting a huge reaction from the crowd in Oxford.

While Freeman didn’t offer an extensive football analysis explaining why he thought the Rebels would win, the reason behind his selection is fairly straightforward given his deep ties to Mississippi.

Freeman's Ole Miss ties explain the pick

Freeman was born in Memphis, Tennessee, but was raised in Mississippi and has maintained a close connection to the state throughout his life. He’s also a familiar face around Ole Miss athletics, particularly at Rebels basketball games, where he has frequently been seen sitting courtside.

His relationship with the university goes beyond simply being a fan. In 2025, the Ole Miss Alumni Association selected Freeman for its Honorary Alumni Award, recognizing his longstanding commitment and support for the university. Ole Miss has also previously honored him with an honorary degree.

Freeman has even spoken publicly about his affection for Ole Miss football and basketball. Ahead of his GameDay appearance, he explained that his connection to the school was one of the reasons he agreed to take part in the show.

That makes his decision to pick the Rebels far less surprising.

There’s also the Kiffin factor. Kiffin coached Ole Miss from 2020 through 2025 before leaving for LSU, turning Saturday’s game into an especially emotional occasion for Rebels fans.

The atmosphere in Oxford is expected to be intense, with Kiffin acknowledging that LSU had prepared its players for heckling and the emotional pressure surrounding his return.

The matchup itself was already significant, with both teams ranked inside the top 10. It also marked the first time since 1962 that Ole Miss and LSU met while both ranked in the top 10.

While Freeman’s famous voice may have made the pick sound particularly authoritative, his reasoning appears rooted more in loyalty than analytics.

articles.title: Jeremiah Smith sets an Ohio State receiving record closing in on even more Buckeyes history
articles.standfirst: Smith needs six more touchdown receptions this season to set a new Buckeyes record
articles.summary: Smith needs six more touchdown receptions this season to set a new Buckeyes record
articles.body:
The 2026 college football season has been a whirlwind of high-stakes drama for the Ohio State Buckeyes , who entered Saturday looking to firmly reestablish their national championship ambitions.

After stumbling out of the gate with a tough early-season loss to powerhouse Texas , the Buckeyes bounced back in emphatic fashion today by delivering a dominant, statement-making blowout 59-3 win against Kent State University .

While the entire roster clicked on all cylinders to right the ship, the afternoon belonged entirely to superstar wide receiver Jeremiah Smith , who put on a historic clinic inside Ohio Stadium and etched his name permanently into the storied record books of college football’s most famous receiver factory.

Jeremiah Smith Shatters Michael Jenkins’ Career Record

Heading into Saturday's matchup against Kent State , the junior phenom, projected by ESPN as a guaranteed top-five selection in next year's NFL draft , was already operating on a historical tier of his own.

After racking up a jaw-dropping 1,315 receiving yards as a true freshman two years ago followed by another 1,243 yards last season , Smith had already accumulated 315 yards and 3 touchdowns through Ohio State's first 2 games of the 2026 campaign.

His combined totals of 2,558 receiving yards and 27 touchdown grabs from 2024 to 2025 already stood as the most by any Big Ten receiver through their first two years in college history.

Needing just a few more catches to rewrite more program milestones, Smith officially shattered Michael Jenkins ’ long-standing career receiving yardage record of 2,898 yards on a brilliant 23-yard grab during the Buckeyes' second offensive possession.

With that catch, Smith claimed the crown and now stands just 6 touchdowns away from surpassing Chris Olave’s school record of 35 career scoring receptions , while also closing in on Emeka Egbuka’s program benchmark of 205 total receptions.

This latest feat cements Smith's legacy alongside an elite fraternity of modern Ohio State wide receiver legends, including Michael Thomas , Terry McLaurin , Chris Olave , Garrett Wilson , Jaxon Smith-Njigba , and Emeka Egbuka , who have all transformed Columbus into the premier breeding ground for elite NFL pass-catchers.

articles.title: Bill Belichick was winning at Clemson and still wanted more as Jordon Hudson watched his new chapter unfold
articles.standfirst: At 74, with North Carolina ahead and 25-year-old Jordon Hudson beside him in a surprising new stage of life, the legendary coach still appeared to want more
articles.summary: At 74, with North Carolina ahead and 25-year-old Jordon Hudson beside him in a surprising new stage of life, the legendary coach still appeared to want more
articles.body:
o rth Carolina held an 11-point lead, but anyone looking only at Bill Belichick’s expression might have assumed his team was being dominated. The 74-year-old coach stood on the Clemson sideline with the same serious face that accompanied six Super Bowl championships and decades of famously uncomfortable interviews.

ESPN captured the moment with UNC leading Clemson 14-3 early in the second quarter. When sideline reporter Stormy Buonantony asked about his team’s performance, Belichick offered short answers and immediately focused on the penalties and mistakes that still needed to be corrected.

This is a perfect example of why Bill Belichick is never satisfied. Of course, his girlfriend Jordon Hudson may have something to do with it. When love enters your life, it brings energy and motivation, becoming part of the drive to keep pursuing more. And when it comes to football, Bill always wants more, no performance ever completely satisfies him.

Belichick was winning in Death Valley, beginning another promising season at North Carolina and sharing his life with a girlfriend nearly five decades younger than him. Yet he remains a man who is always searching for something more.

Bill Belichick remains difficult to satisfy

Belichick, 74, and Jordon Hudson, 25 , reportedly began dating in early 2023 after meeting on a flight in 2021. Their relationship became public in June 2024, meaning they have now been together for approximately three years despite the criticism, jokes and constant attention surrounding their 49-year age difference.

Hudson has accompanied him during his transition from the NFL to college football and was recently present on the North Carolina sideline. Belichick has insisted that she has no role in football decisions, explaining that she only assists with his personal schedule and activities away from the program. He described reports suggesting otherwise as a “flat-out lie.” The couple’s unconventional relationship nevertheless remains part of the public fascination surrounding his new life at UNC.

On the field, North Carolina entered the Clemson game undefeated at 2-0 and as a three-point underdog. The Tar Heels built a 17-6 halftime advantage before Clemson reduced the margin during the third quarter. Play was later delayed with UNC still leading 17-15, preventing the result from becoming official at that moment.

Whether it is a comfortable lead, an incomplete performance or the unconventional personal chapter he has chosen at 74, Belichick’s reaction remains familiar.

The scoreboard may show North Carolina winning, but his face continues to suggest that victory alone is never enough. The team must play well and avoid mistakes, yet there is always something to correct and something to improve.

articles.title: Marvins Antoine cause of death: UMass Dartmouth football player dies at 18
articles.standfirst: Antoine’s death came just hours after UMass Dartmouth’s football team played Framingham State
articles.summary: Antoine’s death came just hours after UMass Dartmouth’s football team played Framingham State
articles.body:
Marvins Antoine, an 18-year-old University of Massachusetts Dartmouth football player, died after being stabbed in Providence, Rhode Island , early Saturday, according to police and university officials.

Antoine , a freshman running back from Fall River, Massachusetts, had been with fellow UMass Dartmouth football players at Mezzo Lounge on Charles Street on Friday night. Police said an altercation later moved outside and across the street to the parking lot of a nearby Wendy's at about 12:30 a.m.

Two UMass Dartmouth players were stabbed during the incident. Antoine suffered stab wounds to his chest and was transported to Rhode Island Hospital, where he was later pronounced dead.

Another freshman player, 19-year-old defensive back Kensley Macean, was also hospitalized. His injuries to the head, neck and left arm were described by police as non-life-threatening.

The circumstances that led to the confrontation remain under investigation. Providence police said an altercation involving a woman and people waiting in line at the nightclub preceded the incident.

Authorities have also said they currently have no indication that Antoine and the suspected attacker knew each other.

What is known about the investigation

Police arrested 19-year-old UMass Dartmouth student Chukuwnonoso Uzoma Eze on campus following the stabbing. Eze isn't a member of the football team.

He was being held by UMass Dartmouth police while arrangements were made to bring him to Rhode Island to face a murder charge, according to Providence police.

Investigators said Flock camera footage in the area helped them identify the vehicle allegedly used to leave the scene. That information reportedly assisted authorities in locating Eze on the UMass Dartmouth campus.

Police haven't released a complete account of what triggered the confrontation or described the full sequence of events leading to the stabbing. The investigation remains active, and additional details could emerge as authorities continue their work.

UMass Dartmouth said there was no known ongoing threat to its campus community following the incident. University officials expressed condolences to Antoine's family, friends, classmates and teammates, while also wishing Macean a full recovery.

“We are heartbroken to share that first-year student and football team member Marvins Antoine passed away this morning following an incident in Providence, Rhode Island,” read a statement from the football team.

“Our thoughts are with Marvins' family, friends, classmates, and teammates.”

Antoine had graduated from B.M.C. Durfee High School in Fall River before beginning his college career at UMass Dartmouth. articles.title: Who Is CJ Bailey? NC State QB faces fan backlash after crushing game-losing fumble
articles.standfirst: CJ Bailey had the win in his hands — then one mistake turned NC State’s victory into a nightmare.
articles.summary: CJ Bailey had the win in his hands — then one mistake turned NC State’s victory into a nightmare.
articles.body:
N C State was seconds away from a signature upset over Vanderbilt on Saturday — until quarterback CJ Bailey turned a near-certain victory into one of the most painful losses in recent Wolfpack history.

With six seconds left and NC State leading 31-28 , Bailey took the snap from his own end zone. The plan was simple: take a safety, kill the clock, and walk away with the win. Giving up two points was acceptable. A turnover was not.

Then the unthinkable happened.

As Bailey tried to absorb contact and protect the ball, he lost control in the end zone. Vanderbilt recovered the fumble and returned it for a game-winning touchdown. What had been a 31-28 lead instantly became a stunning 35-31 defeat.

The collapse was almost statistically impossible. According to ESPN Insights, NC State had a 99.9% win probability before the fumble. Over the previous 20 seasons, teams leading with possession in the final 10 seconds of regulation were 1,046-1.

Bailey becomes the target of fan fury

Despite a solid individual performance — 275 yards and three touchdowns — Bailey’s final mistake erased everything that came before it. Social media erupted with criticism directed squarely at the quarterback.

“CJ Bailey should NEVER play another game in a State uniform. No coming back from this,” one fan wrote.

Another added: “I’d cut CJ Bailey and fire the entire coaching staff while they’re walking off the field. Unacceptable.”

Some called for Bailey to lose his starting job. Others demanded sweeping changes to the program after the heartbreaking loss.

Bailey had produced several strong moments throughout the afternoon. One catastrophic error, however, turned him into the face of one of the most agonizing defeats NC State has suffered in recent memory.

articles.title: Jeremiah Smith sets the standards very high and sends a direct message to the NFL
articles.standfirst: Jeremiah Smith has already made Ohio State history, but the Buckeyes star isn’t satisfied yet and is now chasing two more legendary records.
articles.summary: Jeremiah Smith has already made Ohio State history, but the Buckeyes star isn’t satisfied yet and is now chasing two more legendary records.
articles.body:
Ohio State put the tough loss to the Texas Longhorns in Week 2 behind them with a dominant 59-3 victory over Kent State , though the night also confirmed that Jeremiah Smith still has the hunger to keep making history.

The Buckeyes’ star receiver turned in a modest performance by his own standards with 85 receiving yards, but he still reached a new milestone by surpassing Michael Jenkins as the program’s all-time leader in receiving yards.

However, Smith made it clear he is not satisfied with simply writing a new page in the Ohio State record books. After the game, he said he felt “blessed” by the achievement and highlighted the work that went into it, but he immediately set his sights on two more records.

“I have two more to get, Chris Olave’s touchdowns record and Emeka Egbuka, receptions,” Smith said.

Olave starred for the Buckeyes from 2018 to 2021 before heading to the NFL with the New Orleans Saints , while Egbuka was one of Ohio State’s standout players from 2021 to 2024 and currently plays for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers . Now Smith is chasing two of the most accomplished receivers in the program’s recent history.

Ohio State’s offense responded with authority after the loss to Texas. The Buckeyes dominated Kent State with a 527-134 advantage in total yards, including 382 passing yards in a performance led by quarterback Julian Sayin.

The signal-caller completed 18 of 22 passes for 241 yards and two touchdowns, while six different receivers recorded at least two catches — a clear sign of the team’s offensive depth.

After the stumble against the Longhorns, Sayin expressed confidence in his teammates and appears to have regained stability heading into the most demanding stretch of the season.

Week 4 will mark Ohio State’s return to Big Ten play, when the Illinois Fighting Illini, coached by Bret Bielema , visit the Horseshoe to face Ryan Day’s Buckeyes .

Ohio State will enter as the favorite, but Illinois represents another test for a team looking to solidify itself. For Smith, it will be another opportunity to keep closing in on the records he still has firmly in his sights.

articles.title: Arch Manning risks his career and sending his helmet flying in shocking collision
articles.standfirst: Arch Manning’s scary collision raises concerns after reckless run leaves him without his helmet.
articles.summary: Arch Manning’s scary collision raises concerns after reckless run leaves him without his helmet.
articles.body:
Maximum concern erupted after Arch Manning was seen taking what many considered a completely unnecessary risk during the Week 3 College Football matchup between the Texas Longhorns and UTSA .

It was not the best performance for the quarterback projected to be one of the first selections in the next NFL Draft if he decides to declare. Manning finished with 164 total yards and two touchdown passes, while also rushing for 50 yards .

However, one play in particular stole the spotlight. In the second quarter, with Texas in control of the game 17-3, Manning decided to leave the protection of his offensive line and take off running. He was met by as many as three UTSA defenders on a collision that sent his helmet flying off.

Several users on social media described the play as irresponsible and unnecessary — and they have a point.

How did Texas fare against UTSA?

Arch Manning threw two early touchdown passes to Cam Coleman but struggled throughout the night as No. 1 Texas defeated UTSA 30-6 in the Longhorns ’ final game before beginning their SEC schedule.

Texas (3-0) remained No. 1 in the rankings after defeating Ohio State last week with a 21-point fourth-quarter comeback led by Manning. However, against the Roadrunners, the quarterback completed just 16 of 32 passes for 161 yards, took several hard hits and left the game with six minutes remaining once the outcome had already been decided.

Coleman opened the scoring after Rasheem Biles intercepted UTSA on the first play of the game and added his second touchdown on a spectacular leaping catch in the corner of the end zone to give Texas a 17-3 lead in the second quarter.

Gianni Spetic added three field goals, and freshman Derrick Cooper capped the victory with his first career college rushing touchdown. Texas’ defense continued its dominant form, allowing just 143 total yards and keeping UTSA out of the end zone.

The Longhorns will now face No. 15 Tennessee in their SEC debut.

articles.title: "He's nothing without Brady": UNC fans call for Bill Belichick's head after collapse against Clemson
articles.standfirst: North Carolina surrendered a 17-6 halftime advantage in a 28-20 defeat to Clemson, prompting a wave of criticism toward Bill Belichick after the Tar Heels' second-half collapse
articles.summary: North Carolina surrendered a 17-6 halftime advantage in a 28-20 defeat to Clemson, prompting a wave of criticism toward Bill Belichick after the Tar Heels' second-half collapse
articles.body:
B ill Belichick 's second season at North Carolina has suffered an early setback, and the manner of Saturday's defeat to Clemson has quickly intensified criticism surrounding the veteran coach.

The Tar Heels appeared to be in control for much of the opening half at Memorial Stadium, taking a 17-6 lead into the break. Instead of finishing the job, however, UNC was outscored 22-3 after halftime as Clemson completed a comeback to win 28-20.

The game was already unusual before the final whistle. A lengthy weather delay meant the contest lasted nearly six hours, but neither the stoppage nor the difficult conditions could change the fact that North Carolina had established a significant advantage before failing to protect it.

The Associated Press reported that the game included a 2½-hour weather delay.

Clemson's comeback also gave the Tigers their first ACC victory of the season. Freshman quarterback Tait Reynolds, making his first career start, completed 20 of 29 passes for 215 yards, one touchdown and one interception.

Running back Gideon Davidson added 105 rushing yards and scored the go-ahead touchdown with five minutes remaining.

For UNC, the offense struggled badly after halftime. Quarterback Billy Edwards Jr. finished 13 of 30 passing for 135 yards, with one touchdown and one interception.

Benjamin Hall was a bright spot on the ground, rushing for 130 yards on 18 carries, but the Tar Heels could not maintain the offensive momentum they had established early.

The result dropped North Carolina to 2-1 and handed Clemson its second victory of the season. It also extended Clemson's winning streak against the Tar Heels to eight games.

UNC fans turn their frustration toward Bill Belichick

The disappointing finish immediately spilled over onto social media, where some Tar Heels supporters questioned whether Belichick should remain in charge.

One fan wrote, “Bill Belichick will complete his destiny of being fired at UNC!!! Like every job that doesn’t include Bill Parcels or Tom Brady.”

Another supporter went even further, writing, “This is exactly the reason why Bill Belichick got fired from the Cleveland Browns in 1995,” before adding, “When you get fired by the Browns, you don’t belong coaching. It’s just a matter of weeks until he’s fired from the Tar Heels after this. This inexcusable, unforgivable display of ignominious capitulation. This is unacceptable.”

Other reactions included, “ Bill Belichick ‘there’s a 90% chance I’m already fired’ after that Clemson loss,” while another fan claimed, “Bill Belichick needs to be fired. He is nothing without Brady.”

Cole Thompson also criticized the performance, posting, “Bill Belichick should be fired simply for nearly ruining Gio Lopez at UNC.”

The comments reflect frustration from a fan base that expected Belichick's arrival to change the trajectory of the program. His first season in Chapel Hill did not meet those expectations, as North Carolina finished 4-8 in 2025 and missed a bowl game.

Saturday's defeat therefore carries additional significance because it came against a major ACC opponent and followed a promising 2-0 start. The Tar Heels had beaten TCU in Dublin and East Tennessee State before traveling to Clemson , according to preseason and current-season reporting.

There are also broader circumstances surrounding the program. North Carolina recently concluded an internal investigation into its football operation, with defensive coordinator Steve Belichick set to leave the program in October following medical leave.

The university said the investigation found certain conduct violations but characterized the incidents as isolated rather than systemic, and Bill Belichick was not disciplined.

That backdrop makes the timing of the Clemson loss particularly difficult for the program.

Still, one defeat does not determine the remainder of a season. North Carolina has a bye next weekend before returning home to face Notre Dame on October 3, giving Belichick and his staff an opportunity to address what went wrong in Clemson.

The immediate issue is clear: UNC built a 17-6 halftime lead but could not sustain it. Clemson scored 22 points after the break, turned the game around and left North Carolina with its first loss of the season.

For Belichick , the response to that collapse will now become an important part of the early story surrounding his second season in Chapel Hill. The social-media calls for his dismissal are the reaction of individual fans, rather than evidence that North Carolina has made a decision about his position.

But after such a dramatic second-half turnaround, the pressure surrounding the Tar Heels has unquestionably increased.

articles.title: Deion Sanders furious with Colorado players sideline antics after crushing loss at Northwestern
articles.standfirst: Sanders was angry about turnovers, penalties and the reaction of some players after the 41-7 defeat
articles.summary: Sanders was angry about turnovers, penalties and the reaction of some players after the 41-7 defeat
articles.body:
Deion Sanders was willing to accept that Colorado had been outplayed. What he wasn't willing to accept was seeing players smiling and laughing after a 41-7 loss.

The Buffaloes were overwhelmed by Northwestern on Saturday night in Evanston, falling to 2-1 after a game defined by turnovers, penalties and failed fourth-down attempts.

Sanders called it a “flat out buttkicking” afterward and acknowledged that the Wildcats had simply been better prepared. Yet his sharpest criticism came when he described seeing some of his players appear too relaxed in the immediate aftermath.

“I also don't understand how guys took joy in a loss because I'm walking up behind you,” Sanders said. “I can't never understand that because I want to win every darn thing.”

He continued: “And I can't understand how, in the world, you can find joy and a laughing matter when I'm walking in. I had to address that.”

Turnovers buried Colorado

Sanders had plenty of football reasons to be frustrated. Colorado committed four turnovers and struggled to sustain drives, while Northwestern repeatedly turned mistakes into points.

Micah Welch and Damian Henderson II both lost fumbles, and quarterback Julian Lewis threw two interceptions.

Lewis finished 19-of-28 for 168 yards and one touchdown, but Colorado never found enough rhythm to threaten a comeback. Sanders said the Wildcats forced the Buffaloes into poor decisions.

“They forced us into bad decisions and doing things that’s not truly who we are,” he said. “They did a better job coaching than we did. But the turnovers and the penalties, there's no way you can win like that.”

Sanders already warned team about standards

The postgame frustration fit a pattern. Only a week earlier, Colorado had beaten Weber State 52-21, yet Sanders still criticized his team’s discipline and overall standard despite the comfortable result.

That message was about refusing to confuse a win with a complete performance, and Saturday’s defeat gave him an even stronger reason to revisit it.

Northwestern quarterback Aidan Chiles added to Colorado’s problems, producing what Sanders described as the best game he had seen him play. Chiles completed 17 of 22 passes for 241 yards and helped Northwestern consistently exploit Colorado’s defense.

The Buffaloes now have to move quickly. Big 12 play begins next week at Baylor, and Sanders made clear there is little value in dwelling on the Northwestern loss beyond fixing what went wrong.

“You've got to flush it because the Big 12 is next week,” he said. That process, though, will apparently include more than correcting turnovers and penalties.

Sanders also wants to make sure his players understand how he expects them to respond when they lose.

articles.title: From lawsuit threat to hanging out: Pat McAfee spotted with Ole Miss student from viral rumor scandal
articles.standfirst: The ESPN host was seen talking with the Ole Miss student more than a year after publicly apologizing to her family
articles.summary: The ESPN host was seen talking with the Ole Miss student more than a year after publicly apologizing to her family
articles.body:
P at McAfee ’s latest visit to Ole Miss carried an uncomfortable piece of history with it, and Saturday brought an unexpected image that quickly caught attention online.

The ESPN personality was photographed talking with Mary Kate Cornett on the sideline at Vaught-Hemingway Stadium before Ole Miss ’ game against LSU , more than a year after his show discussed a false sexual rumor about her that later became the subject of public apologies and threatened legal action.

McAfee was in Oxford for College GameDay, while Cornett had also attended the game with friends. Video showed the two standing near one another before kickoff, and a fan later posted a photo of them talking. The scene was notable because of what happened in 2025.

Cornett , then an Ole Miss student, became the target of an anonymous online rumor falsely alleging that she had been involved in a sexual relationship with her boyfriend’s father. The claim spread rapidly across social media before being picked up by prominent sports personalities, including McAfee .

McAfee later acknowledged damage caused

Cornett and her family strongly criticized McAfee after he discussed the rumor on-air without first contacting them or establishing whether it was true. Cornett later described the impact of the amplification in stark terms.

“They don’t think it matters, because they don’t know who I am and they think that I deserve it,” she said. “But I don’t. You’re ruining my life by talking about it on your show for nothing but attention.”

Months later, McAfee issued a direct apology after meeting Cornett and her family privately.

“I have since learned that the story was not true, and that my show played a role in the anguish caused to a great family and especially to a young woman, Mary Kate Cornett,” McAfee said.

He also admitted that his program “had no personal knowledge about Mary Kate or her personal life.”

Cornett ordeal extended beyond social media

Cornett said the attention affected her daily life, with strangers harassing her and personal information circulating online.

“But here I am staying up until 5 in the morning, every night, throwing up, not eating because I’m so anxious about what’s going to happen for the rest of my life,” she said.

Her family also said manipulated photographs and AI-generated material were circulated alongside the false allegation. Cornett ’s attorney later said the dispute with McAfee had been resolved satisfactorily after his apology and meeting with the family.

That makes Saturday’s sideline encounter more significant than an ordinary celebrity photo.

After a controversy that once placed McAfee and Cornett on opposite sides of a potential legal dispute, the pair were seen speaking casually at the same stadium where the fallout had once become a major story.

articles.title: College Football: Colorado State condemns hateful fan chants aimed at BYU's faith
articles.standfirst: The latest incident came during the Cougars’ 41-23 road victory and followed similar episodes in recent seasons
articles.summary: The latest incident came during the Cougars’ 41-23 road victory and followed similar episodes in recent seasons
articles.body:
B YU ’s 41-23 victory over Colorado State should have been remembered primarily for another strong performance from an unbeaten team. Instead, the night also produced a familiar and troubling subplot when a section of the home crowd directed a profane anti-Mormon chant toward the Cougars .

The chant of “f*** the Mormons” was heard inside Canvas Stadium during Saturday’s game, prompting Colorado State to issue a formal apology to BYU, its athletes, supporters and members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

“Mocking anyone's faith has no place at CSU,” the university said. “It runs counter to our community's values and to who we are. BYU's players, coaches and fans deserved better. We are addressing this with our students.”

The incident continued a pattern BYU has encountered at road sporting events in recent years, including a similar episode involving Colorado football last season.

Sitake refuses to let small group define Colorado State

BYU coach Kalani Sitake chose not to dwell on the chant after the game and instead made a point of separating the people involved from the wider Colorado State fan base.

“I think the chants [are] mostly a minority of people and fans,” Sitake said. “There's some amazing fans here in Fort Collins, so I'm not too worried about that.”

He added: “We're not going to judge an entire fan base on a few … of the ones that made their chants.”

Sitake later praised the overall atmosphere and said he knew too many good people connected to Colorado State to allow one incident to shape his view of the school.

“Everyone's human and I'm not going to dwell on that,” he said. “I know amazing people that are Colorado State fans and alumni and I'm just going to focus on the beautiful people that are positives.”

His response echoed BYU ’s broader approach to similar incidents.

BYU repeatedly called for religious respect

After comparable chants at previous events, BYU has argued that criticism of its faith reaches far beyond the players and coaches wearing the school’s colors.

“We can all agree that there is certain fan behavior at athletic events that crosses a line,” BYU said in a statement last year. “We would hope that more people could see that disparaging someone's religion crosses that line.”

The school also stressed that members of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints can be found throughout college sports, including among opposing fan bases, coaching staffs and athletic departments.

Colorado was fined $50,000 by the Big 12 last year after a similar chant, with commissioner Brett Yormark saying the conference had “zero tolerance” for hateful or discriminatory language.

Other schools, including Oregon, Arizona and Cincinnati , have also apologized after incidents involving BYU teams.

Saturday’s episode therefore felt less like an isolated outburst and more like the latest example of an issue BYU has repeatedly confronted.

articles.summary: Deion “Coach Prime” Sanders has never been shy about demanding a certain standard from his Colorado program. After Saturday’s 41-7 loss at Northwestern, that standard extended beyond what happened between the lines. Sanders expressed his displeasure after seeing some Colorado players laughing following the Buffaloes’ most lopsided defeat of the season. The reaction came after a game in which Colorado repeatedly gave Northwestern opportunities and struggled to turn its offensive possessions into points. The Buffaloes moved the ball reasonably well, finishing with 348 total yards, but seven drives ended without points. Four turnovers and three failed fourth-down attempts proved costly as Colorado dropped to 2-1.

articles.title: Ole Miss star Trinidad Chambliss apologizes to Holly Rowe for postgame F-bomb
articles.standfirst: The rising Heisman contender apologized to Holly Rowe after an expletive slipped out during his postgame interview
articles.summary: The rising Heisman contender apologized to Holly Rowe after an expletive slipped out during his postgame interview
articles.body:
Trinidad Chambliss had every reason to be emotional after Ole Miss finished off one of its biggest wins of the season.

The Rebels quarterback had just thrown for 363 yards and two touchdowns, added another score on the ground and helped Ole Miss beat LSU 32-24 in Oxford.

The victory pushed the Rebels to 3-0 and further elevated Chambliss into the early Heisman conversation. Then came a moment he quickly regretted.

During his on-field interview with ESPN reporter Holly Rowe , Chambliss praised his preparation and faith before ending the exchange with an expletive-laced version of the Ole Miss “Hotty Toddy” chant.

“I just trust in God. I trust in my preparation as well. We worked our butts off this whole week and this whole year, and it's just go and do it,” Chambliss told Rowe .

After she thanked him, he shouted, “Thank you so much. Hotty [expletive] toddy!” and ran off to celebrate.

The language drew criticism, and Chambliss addressed it publicly the following day.

“Emotions were high,” Chambliss said Sunday. “That’s the best play in football, you know, being in victory formation. But yeah, my emotions were high after the game. I got kind of caught up in the moment with the interview.

“That’s not who I am, so I deeply, I'm deeply apologetic to Holly Rowe and, you know, everyone out there who was listening. That's not who I am.”

The apology came after a night that carried plenty of emotional weight beyond the final score.

LSU erased a 24-7 deficit with 17 unanswered points, turning what had looked like a comfortable Ole Miss win into a fourth-quarter fight. Chambliss responded when the Rebels needed him most.

With the game tied, he helped lead the decisive drive and then scored on a 14-yard run to put Ole Miss back in front.

“I tried to stay calm, you know, throughout the whole game regardless of the situation,” Chambliss said. “Can’t get too high, can’t get too low.”

He finished 33-of-48 passing and accounted for 365 total yards and three touchdowns, earning SEC Offensive Player of the Week honors.

Win meant more than beating Lane Kiffin

The matchup also had another layer because former Ole Miss coach Lane Kiffin was on the opposite sideline with LSU .

“This one meant a lot more than the other games,” Chambliss said. “I wanted this one really bad and our team did too.

“I feel like the whole nation just kind of like disrespects Ole Miss. I’m happy that we got this win for our fans and the people that support Ole Miss.”

Chambliss left Saturday as one of the hottest quarterbacks in college football. By Sunday, he was also reminding people how quickly an emotional celebration can become part of the story.

articles.title: Deion Sanders gets an unexpected new role at Colorado that brings his influence beyond the sidelines
articles.standfirst: Sander will be added to the game with the new update on Tuesday
articles.summary: Sander will be added to the game with the new update on Tuesday
articles.body:
The 2026 College Football season has been nothing short of a rollercoaster ride for the Colorado Buffaloes . Entering September with high expectations, the team opened the year with a thrilling, hard-fought 14-13 victory over Georgia Tech , followed by an explosive 52-21 blowout win against Weber State .

However, momentum hit a brick wall during their Week 3 matchup, resulting in a humbling 41-7 thrashing at the hands of the Northwestern Wildcats . With a challenging conference schedule ahead, head coach Deion Sanders finds his program under intense scrutiny as they attempt to balance on-field adjustments with mounting external pressure.

Coach Prime Expands His Reach Into EA Sports College Football 27

While the Buffaloes navigate the ups and downs of their autumn campaign, Coach Prime has officially expanded his massive cultural footprint far beyond the real-life sidelines in Boulder.

According to a social media announcement from the franchise, Deion Sanders has been officially added to EA Sports College Football 27 , with the update rolling out to players everywhere.

"Coach Prime is in the game," the release stated, encouraging fans to "Do it for U by calling the shots in Boulder with Deion Sanders." Alongside new coaches, mascots, and gameplay enhancements, gamers can step directly into the digital shoes of the Hall of Fame icon.

This virtual integration arrives at a critical juncture for Colorado. Before Sanders arrived in Boulder to perform an emergency overhaul of the program's culture, the university endured six consecutive losing seasons between 2017 and 2022, culminating in a dismal 1-11 campaign.

Over three seasons at the helm, Sanders holds a polarizing 17-22 overall record , highlighted by a 9-4 finish and an Alamo Bowl appearance in 2024 before slipping to a difficult 3-9 mark last year.

Armed with a lucrative five-year, $54 million contract running through 2029, Sanders and the Buffaloes must quickly rebound as they kick off Big 12 conference play on the road against Baylor , followed by a high-stakes home clash against ranked Texas Tech .

Whether on the gridiron or through the glowing screen of a video game, Coach Prime's undeniable gravity continues to dominate the national sports conversation

articles.title: Arch Manning puts Texas in the College Football Playoff spotlight as the Longhorns emerge as the team to beat
articles.standfirst: Texas will play six of their next seven games against ranked opponents
articles.summary: Texas will play six of their next seven games against ranked opponents
articles.body:
The college football season is moving fast. Teams are lining up for their fourth game this weekend, and for the first time since 2023 there will be six AP-ranked matchups on the same day . The headliners include Texas (No. 1) vs. Tennessee (No. 14) , Ole Miss (No. 4) vs. Florida (No. 21) , and Iowa (No. 17) vs. Michigan (No. 18) , with three of those six earning their first loss of the season.

For the Texas Longhorns , still the best team in the country at 3-0, Saturday in Knoxville is the first road game of the year and the start of a brutal stretch. Seven of their last nine games are against teams currently in the Top 25 , including Ole Miss (No. 4) and LSU (No. 10).

Texas Leads Playoff Odds as Manning Sets Up a Heisman and Draft Run

Texas is off to a strong start, and ESPN’s playoff model now gives the Longhorns the best shot in the country at reaching the College Football Playoff at 85% after they missed the field last year. Notre Dame sits next at 81% and Miami at 78%.

Those two, like Texas with Arch Manning , have first-round caliber quarterbacks in CJ Carr and Darian Mensah who can win games and could hear their names called early in the next NFL Draft .

Even with the remaining schedule, it is hard to picture Texas staying home in December. Manning has thrown for 664 yards and seven touchdowns through three games.

If the Longhorns finish in the top four, the group that gets a first-round bye, and beat most of these ranked opponents, Manning will be a real Heisman candidate and a top prospect for the 2027 NFL Draft .

After this weekend they get a bye, then the Red River Rivalry against Oklahoma, then five games against currently ranked teams: Florida, Ole Miss and Mississippi State at home, Missouri and LSU on the road.

articles.title: Eli Manning warns his nephew Arch following the heated controversy over laughing at an AI video: “They’re not your friends”
articles.standfirst: The Super Bowl champion offers strong words of advice to the Texas Longhorns star.
articles.summary: The Super Bowl champion offers strong words of advice to the Texas Longhorns star.
articles.body:
Arch Manning has received some timely advice from his uncle Eli after a bizarre media controversy overshadowed Texas Longhorns ’ dramatic victory over the Ohio State Buckeyes earlier this month. The young quarterback sparked backlash after revealing that he had laughed at an AI-generated video appearing to show coach Steve Sarkisian slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe .

Arch later apologized to Rowe via Instagram Stories, but the incident offered a lesson about how quickly a seemingly harmless joke can spread and take on a life of its own and Eli is keen to drill the lesson home. “He'll have to figure out that media on his own,” Manning indirectly said to Arch, via Front Office Sports. “And a lot of it is just kind of growing pains. “You feel like media's your pal, you relax with them a little bit, you try to be funny, and then they can take it and run. You gotta be careful.”

Arch Manning has tough night as Longhorns brush UTSA Roadrunners aside

Arch then endured a difficult night on the college football field despite Texas defeating the UTSA Roadrunners 30-6, as he finished 16-of-32 passing for 161 yards in the Longhorns ’ final game before SEC play. The sophomore quarterback did connect with Cam Coleman twice for touchdowns, but he struggled to find consistency and absorbed several heavy hits while Texas dealt with shaky pass protection. The performance came after Arch had produced a spectacular fourth-quarter comeback against Ohio State , throwing Texas back into the game before the Longhorns completed a 24-23 victory. Texas improved to 3-0 with the win over UTSA , but the quarterback acknowledged afterward that his performance was not good enough ahead of the much tougher schedule ahead in the race to the College Football Playoffs . Arch 's night included several missed opportunities, with the quarterback missing open receivers and overthrowing others while repeatedly scrambling away from pressure, with his helmet knocked off following a heavy collision in the second quarter. The UTSA defense that continued to pressure the quarterback, but it was a different story on the other side of the ball as the Longhorns ' defense continued its impressive start by limiting their opponent to 143 total yards and no touchdowns. Arch and Texas now turn their attention to Tennessee on Saturday, September 26 , with the quarterback facing a significantly tougher test against the Volunteers .

articles.title: Lane Kiffin's LSU problems keep mounting: Criminal investigation launched for Tigers player's alleged sexual assault
articles.standfirst: A concerning situation from last year is rearing its ugly head.
articles.summary: A concerning situation from last year is rearing its ugly head.
articles.body:
Last weekend did not go as Lane Kiffin had it planned. Making a return to Ole Miss , this time as a villain of the Rebels, Kiffin watched as his LSU Tigers lost the game 32-24 on a fourth quarter touchdown from Trinidad Chambliss - the star quarterback he helped recruit to Ole Miss before leaving.

It was definitely a hostile environment for Kiffin, although it wasn't nearly as bad as some expected. Now, Kiffin's attention must shift to getting LSU back on track . A bounce-back won't come easy, as No. 23 Texas A&M are coming to visit. As if Kiffin didn't have enough to stress about, there's now a concerning legal situation unfolding with an LSU player .

Criminal investigation underway for alleged sexual assault committed by LSU football player

According to WAFB Channel 9 of Baton Rouge, Louisiana, a criminal investigation is now underway for an alleged sexual assault involving a Tigers football player . This was confirmed by the East Baton Rouge District Attorney's office on Tuesday.

As of right now, the identity of the player that's been accused is unknown . Whether that player is currently on the team right now, is also not known. No charges have been made yet . Regardless, it's bad optics for a football program that would like to avoid any more negative PR going forward.

The sexual assault incident took place in 2025 . The alleged victim posted a detailed account of the incident on her TikTok page (user Kendall Danielle) on September 14, claiming that an LSU football player raped her. This story is developing.

articles.summary: A dangerous road test awaits Texas as Tennessee looks to expose cracks in the Longhorns
articles.body:
Texas ’ perfect start has done little to erase one uncomfortable question: can the Longhorns finally prove they can win away from Austin?

After opening the season 3-0 at home, Steve Sarkisian’s team now heads to Neyland Stadium for one of its toughest tests yet, bringing a troubling road history into the matchup with Tennessee.

CBS analyst Bud Elliott recently highlighted that issue, describing Texas as “legitimately bad” on the road under Sarkisian . The concern isn’t difficult to understand.

Last season, the Longhorns lost 29-21 at Florida and were beaten 35-10 by Georgia. Their two road victories, meanwhile, came against Kentucky and Mississippi State, with both games requiring overtime.

There’s also been increasing attention on Manning away from the field. Following criticism surrounding a viral AI-generated video incident and a separate media controversy involving Sarkisian, Manning has become noticeably more reserved during media sessions.

His recent answers have been brief, offering reporters little opportunity to generate another viral moment.

That won’t matter once the game kicks off. Neyland Stadium will present Manning with an environment unlike anything he’s experienced this season, and Texas’ response could reveal whether its early success can travel.

The challenge for Manning is to turn flashes of elite ability into sustained production against a defense preparing specifically for Texas’ passing attack.

If Texas wants its championship ambitions to remain realistic, proving it can perform under pressure away from Austin may be just as important as anything Manning does with the ball.
